nfe3be4a7878.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the incentives in the Amaravati Quantum Valley?
o: The exemption applies only to registration fees and not to stamp duty
Technology firms get 100% exemption from stamp duty
Technology firms get 100% exemption from registration fees
Andhra Pradesh plans to train 4.5 million people in AI and quantum technologies
nfe3be4a7878.x: The policy gives 100% exemption from both stamp duty and registration fees, so saying it excludes stamp duty is wrong.

n97fdb9dfadf.s: Which of the following National Quantum Mission thematic hubs is wrongly matched with its host?
o: Quantum Materials and Devices – IIT Madras
Quantum Sensing and Metrology – IIT Bombay
n97fdb9dfadf.x: The Quantum Materials and Devices hub is hosted by IIT Delhi, not IIT Madras; IIT Madras hosts the Quantum Communication hub.

n5979af149e2.s:
Assertion (A): Satellite QKD over 2000 km within India is a target of the National Quantum Mission.
Reason (R): Development of magnetometers and atomic clocks is also a technological area of the National Quantum Mission.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n5979af149e2.x: Both are National Quantum Mission objectives, but the magnetometer and atomic-clock work does not explain the satellite QKD target.

n144c3ac5d18.s: Who is the ex officio President of the Governing Board of the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF)?
o: The Union Minister of Science and Technology
n144c3ac5d18.x: Under the ANRF Act, 2023 the Prime Minister is the ex officio President of the ANRF Governing Board (the ANRF subsumed SERB).

n58f9591aec7.s: The supercomputer PARAM Pravega is hosted at:
n58f9591aec7.x: PARAM Pravega is at IISc Bengaluru; PARAM Shivay is at IIT (BHU), PARAM Porul at NIT Tiruchirappalli and PARAM Ananta at IIT Gandhinagar.

n61daeb6a43f.s: In the Bio-E3 Policy (2024), Bio-E3 stands for Biotechnology for Economy, Environment and ____.
n61daeb6a43f.x: Bio-E3 means Biotechnology for Economy, Environment and Employment; its core aim is a bio-manufacturing ecosystem.

n529fa5f6d79.s: The supercomputer Pratyush is located at:
n529fa5f6d79.x: Pratyush is at IITM Pune; Mihir is at NCMRWF Noida, Flosolver at NAL Bengaluru and Anupam at BARC.

na9431112ae0.s: Where is the 1Q Quantum Test and Reference Facility in Andhra Pradesh located?
na9431112ae0.x: The 1Q facility is at Medha Towers, Gannavaram, while the 1S test bed is at SRM University-AP.

nphysics-9-14.s: Which of the following pairs is wrongly matched?
o: Galileo Galilei – Father of Experimental Physics
Isaac Newton – Father of Classical Mechanics
Albert Einstein – Father of Modern Physics
nphysics-9-14.x: Rutherford is the Father of Nuclear Physics; the Father of Relativity is Albert Einstein.

n414be0661e5.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Homi Bhabha and S. N. Bose?
o: Homi Bhabha became an FRS in 1941
Homi Bhabha received the Padma Bhushan in 1954
S. N. Bose received the Padma Vibhushan in 1954
S. N. Bose became an FRS in 1941
n414be0661e5.x: S. N. Bose became an FRS in 1958; it was Homi Bhabha who became an FRS in 1941.

nce0ba367c19.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about early Indian women scientists?
o: Kamala Sohonie was the first woman to obtain a D.Sc. from an Indian university
Anandibai Joshi earned an MD in Western medicine in 1886
Kamala Sohonie was the first woman admitted to IISc
Asima Chatterjee obtained a D.Sc. from Calcutta University in 1944
nce0ba367c19.x: The first woman D.Sc. from an Indian university was Asima Chatterjee (Calcutta, 1944), not Kamala Sohonie.

nphysics-9-9.s:
Assertion (A): J.J. Thomson was associated with the Cavendish Laboratory, Cambridge.
Reason (R): Isaac Newton was associated with the University of Chicago and Columbia.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nphysics-9-9.x: Thomson worked at the Cavendish Laboratory, so A is true; R is false because Newton was at Cambridge and the Royal Society, while Fermi was at Chicago and Columbia.

n1de3f9a4fe5.s:
Assertion (A): India's three-stage nuclear power programme conceived by Homi Bhabha is based on uranium.
Reason (R): Homi Bhabha presided over the first UN Conference on the Peaceful Uses of Atomic Energy at Geneva in 1955.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n1de3f9a4fe5.x: The three-stage programme is thorium-based, so A is false; R is true as Bhabha presided over the 1955 Geneva conference.

nebdc3332fff.s: The particle class 'bosons', named after S.N. Bose, was named by:
nebdc3332fff.x: Paul Dirac coined the name 'bosons'; Bose had sent his paper 'Planck's Law and the Hypothesis of Light Quanta' to Einstein (1924).

nfa7dd19f79a.s: National Mathematics Day, marking the birthday of Srinivasa Ramanujan, is observed on:
nfa7dd19f79a.x: Ramanujan was born on 22 December 1887, and that date is observed as National Mathematics Day.

nphysics-9-15.s: Who is known as the Father of Quantum Theory?
nphysics-9-15.x: Max Planck is the Father of Quantum Theory; Bohr is the Father of Atomic Physics, Raman of Indian Physics and Bhabha of India's nuclear programme.

n6321a02fe86.s: Who was the first woman General President of the Indian Science Congress (1975)?
n6321a02fe86.x: Asima Chatterjee, also the first woman D.Sc. of an Indian university (Calcutta, 1944), became the first woman General President of the Indian Science Congress in 1975.

nphysics-4-13.s: Who is known as the man who 'weighed the Earth'?
nphysics-4-13.x: Henry Cavendish is called the man who weighed the Earth; Oppenheimer is the father of the atomic bomb and Bohr of atomic physics.

nphysics-4-6.s: The hydrogen spectrum was explained by:
nphysics-4-6.x: Bohr explained the hydrogen spectrum; Planck explained black-body radiation, Einstein the photoelectric effect and Maxwell unified electromagnetism.

nf6050ff80ce.s: In which year did C.V. Raman found the Raman Research Institute in Bengaluru?
nf6050ff80ce.x: Raman founded the Raman Research Institute in 1948; he founded the Indian Academy of Sciences in 1934.

ncc377c12599.s: J.C. Bose founded the Bose Institute, Kolkata, in:
ncc377c12599.x: J.C. Bose, who showed that plants respond to stimuli, founded the Bose Institute in Kolkata in 1917.

nphysics-9-5.s: Albert Einstein was associated with which of the following institutions?
nphysics-9-5.x: Einstein worked at Princeton's Institute for Advanced Study; Rutherford was at the Cavendish Laboratory and Manchester, and Bohr at Copenhagen.

nphysics-9-8.s: The scientist Henri Becquerel was associated with which country?
nphysics-9-8.x: Becquerel was French; Marie Curie was associated with both Poland and France.

ndcd6c8c157d.s: Which of the following institutions was established in 1945?
ndcd6c8c157d.x: TIFR was founded in 1945; the Bose Institute dates from 1917, the Indian Academy of Sciences from 1934 and the Raman Research Institute from 1948.

nbiology-14-24.s: The plant geneticist known for breeding high-yield 'Super Rice' is:
nbiology-14-24.x: Gurdev Singh Khush, a plant geneticist, bred high-yield super rice.

nphysics-9-16.s: Who is known as the 'Architect of the Nuclear Age'?
nphysics-9-16.x: Enrico Fermi is called the architect of the nuclear age; Michael Faraday is known as the father of electricity.

nbiology-13-5.s: Biorock reef technology was invented by:
nbiology-13-5.x: Wolf Hilbertz invented Biorock technology; Robert Jarvik made the Jarvik-7 artificial heart.

n48891505ab8.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Yelavarthy Nayudamma?
o: The Kanishka bombing in which he died occurred in 1986
He served as Director of the Central Leather Research Institute, Chennai
He died in the bombing of Air India Flight 182 (Kanishka)
n48891505ab8.x: The Kanishka bombing in which Nayudamma died took place in 1985, not 1986.

n244bee82dac.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about A.P.J. Abdul Kalam?
o: He was the 11th President of India from 2007 to 2012
He was project director of SLV-3, which put Rohini in orbit in 1980
He led the Integrated Guided Missile Development Programme
He is called the 'Missile Man of India'
n244bee82dac.x: Kalam was the 11th President from 2002 to 2007, not 2007 to 2012.

n91c1c9f44b2.s:
Assertion (A): M.S. Swaminathan was associated with the development of high-yielding dwarf varieties of wheat and rice.
Reason (R): M.S. Swaminathan chaired the National Commission on Farmers.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n91c1c9f44b2.x: Both are true, but chairing the National Commission on Farmers does not explain his work on high-yielding dwarf crops.

n84aba96d766.s: Har Gobind Khorana received the Nobel Prize for:
o: Determining the structure of the 30S ribosomal subunit
Interpreting the genetic code and its role in protein synthesis
Discovering the structure of the neutron
n84aba96d766.x: Khorana was recognised for interpreting the genetic code and explaining its role in protein synthesis.

n97e2fe1635d.s: Dr A.P.J. Abdul Kalam was the first Indian Head of State to:
n97e2fe1635d.x: Kalam was the first Indian Head of State to fly a fighter aircraft.

n407e13f60cd.s: INCOSPAR, headed by Vikram Sarabhai from 1962, became ISRO in:
n407e13f60cd.x: INCOSPAR became ISRO in 1969, and Sarabhai served as ISRO's first Chairman until his death in 1971.

nb96f8533dd5.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar (RVP)?
o: Established in 2024, it is India's highest S&T recognition
The Vigyan Team award goes to a team of three or more researchers
Like the Bhatnagar Prize, it covers 7 domains of science
Its Vigyan Yuva-SSB award is for scientists up to 45 years of age
nb96f8533dd5.x: The RVP covers 13 domains; it was the Bhatnagar Prize that had 7 disciplines.

n8d6bba6b459.s:
Assertion (A): John Bardeen received the Nobel Prize in Physics twice, in 1956 and 1972.
Reason (R): Niels Bohr received the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1932.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n8d6bba6b459.x: Bardeen's two Physics Nobels (1956, 1972) are correct, but Bohr won in 1922; 1932 was Heisenberg's year.

n07827e1670a.s:
Assertion (A): The Economics prize was one of the original five prizes specified in Alfred Nobel's will.
Reason (R): The Economics prize was added in 1968 and first awarded in 1969.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n07827e1670a.x: Economics was not among the original five prizes, so A is false; R is true as it was added in 1968 and first awarded in 1969.

n846c1e31915.s: The Chandrasekhar limit, the maximum mass of a stable white dwarf, is about:
n846c1e31915.x: The Chandrasekhar limit is about 1.4 solar masses; beyond it the star collapses into a neutron star or black hole.

n1aa9b694174.s: In which year did Har Gobind Khorana receive the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine?
n1aa9b694174.x: Khorana, then a US citizen, received the 1968 Medicine Nobel for work on the genetic code.

nf442c92463d.s: How many Padma Awards were conferred in 2025?
nf442c92463d.x: The 2025 Padma Awards totalled 139: 7 Padma Vibhushan, 19 Padma Bhushan and 113 Padma Shri.

n712d2324398.s: The first Nobel Prizes were awarded in:
n712d2324398.x: The first prizes were awarded in 1901; 1895 is the year of Alfred Nobel's will.

n63c9883c995.s: Since which year has CSIR awarded the Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize?
n63c9883c995.x: CSIR has awarded the prize since 1958; it is named after CSIR's founder-director S.S. Bhatnagar.

n31083c34f7d.s: The UNESCO Kalinga Prize for the popularisation of science was instituted in 1952 with a donation from:
n31083c34f7d.x: The 1952 donation came from Biju Patnaik through the Kalinga Foundation Trust.

n3afab8d9648.s: RDX, patented in 1898, was discovered by:
n3afab8d9648.x: RDX was discovered by George Friedrich Henning of Germany, not Alfred Nobel, who invented dynamite in 1867.

n3bd6ebcc724.s: C.V. Raman became the first Indian scientist Nobel laureate in:
n3bd6ebcc724.x: Raman became the first Indian scientist laureate in 1930; the first Nobel Prize was awarded in 1901.

n3f172c59952.s: Manjul Bhargava received the Fields Medal in:
n3f172c59952.x: Manjul Bhargava won the Fields Medal in 2014; Akshay Venkatesh won it in 2018.

nda90c50efe5.s: S. Chandrasekhar received the 1983 Nobel Prize in Physics for his work on:
nda90c50efe5.x: Chandrasekhar won the 1983 Physics Nobel for stellar structure and evolution; Raman won in 1930 for light scattering.

n7bf8ad5d5e9.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about types of operating systems?
o: A batch OS groups jobs and runs them without user interaction
In a time-sharing OS such as UNIX, many users share CPU time
Real-time operating systems are used in missile guidance and air-traffic control
Real-time operating systems have no fixed response deadlines
n7bf8ad5d5e9.x: Real-time OS work to fixed response deadlines, which is why they are used for missile guidance and air-traffic control.

n9127c2c8f1e.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about computer performance terms?
o: Bandwidth is the data-transfer rate, measured in bits per second
Word length is the number of bits the CPU handles at once
Clock speed is measured in bits per second
MIPS stands for million instructions per second
n9127c2c8f1e.x: Clock speed is measured in hertz (GHz); bits per second is the unit of bandwidth.

n89ebdd22aed.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about types of computers?
o: Analog computers work on continuous quantities, as in a speedometer
Hybrid computers such as ICU monitors combine analog and digital features
Digital computers, such as PCs, process discrete (binary) data
n89ebdd22aed.x: Digital computers process discrete (binary) data; continuous quantities are the domain of analog computers.

nd61ece3c7e3.s:
Assertion (A): Assembly language (2GL) uses mnemonics.
Reason (R): Assembly language is converted into machine code by a compiler.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nd61ece3c7e3.x: Assembly language does use mnemonics, but it is converted into machine code by an assembler, not a compiler, so R is false.

n4b37a1e2f2a.s:
Assertion (A): Linus Torvalds started the GNU project in 1983.
Reason (R): Linus Torvalds wrote the Linux kernel in 1991.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n4b37a1e2f2a.x: The GNU project (1983) and the GPL licence are Richard Stallman's, so A is false; R is true.

n62adf2ad819.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
n62adf2ad819.x: A device driver is system software, not application software.

n3fb9507e721.s: Which component of the CPU fetches and decodes program instructions?
n3fb9507e721.x: The control unit fetches, decodes and directs; the ALU does arithmetic and logic, and the PSU only supplies power.

nc143219d7a8.s: The 3.1-petaflop supercomputer Param Shakti was launched by MeitY at:
nc143219d7a8.x: Param Shakti, funded under the National Supercomputing Mission, was launched by MeitY at IIT Madras.

nb2a1abcea35.s: Which secondary storage is sequential-access and mainly used for backup and archival?
nb2a1abcea35.x: Magnetic tape is sequential-access, the slowest in the speed order, and used for backup and archival; an SSD uses flash memory with no moving parts.

n7ef57142668.s: Which of the following is an impact printer?
n7ef57142668.x: Dot-matrix and daisy-wheel printers are impact printers; laser, inkjet and thermal printers are non-impact.

n2699a037f91.s: ASCII is a ____-bit character-encoding scheme representing 128 characters.
n2699a037f91.x: ASCII is a 7-bit code (2^7 = 128 characters); Unicode extends its range.

n093e5d8607e.s: Which of the following are known as universal gates?
n093e5d8607e.x: NAND and NOR are the universal gates; AND, OR and NOT are the basic gates.

n0d0632d94df.s: Which type of RAM is used as cache memory?
n0d0632d94df.x: SRAM is used as cache, while DRAM is used as main memory.

nacb926f71fb.s: ICT aims to facilitate communication among:
nacb926f71fb.x: ICT aims at efficient human-human, human-machine and machine-to-machine communication.

n000321e587e.s: The Boolean identity (A + B)′ = A′ · B′ is known as:
n000321e587e.x: (A + B)′ = A′ · B′ is De Morgan's law.

n22fe1047aaa.s: Who is credited with the cut, copy and paste commands?
n22fe1047aaa.x: Larry Tesler is linked with cut, copy and paste; Engelbart with the mouse, Babbage with the Analytical Engine and Lovelace with the first program.

n0634440c4c3.s: The third generation of computers was based on:
n0634440c4c3.x: The generations ran vacuum tubes, transistors, integrated circuits and microprocessors, so the third used integrated circuits.

nc9fb18a4fa9.s: Which of the following has the highest access speed?
nc9fb18a4fa9.x: The speed order is registers, cache, RAM and magnetic tape.

n6ac44766ab1.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about network topologies?
o: In a bus topology, all nodes share one backbone cable
A mesh topology links every node to every other node
In a ring topology, each node is linked to two neighbours
In a star topology, failure of one node stops the whole network
n6ac44766ab1.x: In a star, a failed node is only isolated; it is a hub failure that stops the whole network.

n00b43a560d2.s: Which of the following OSI layers is wrongly matched with its function?
o: Data Link – MAC addressing and frame forwarding
n00b43a560d2.x: Encryption, compression and formats belong to the Presentation layer; the Transport layer uses TCP and UDP.

n543d00b9de6.s: BhashaNet (2022), which promotes Universal Acceptance for Indian languages, is an initiative of:
n543d00b9de6.x: BhashaNet is a MeitY-NIXI initiative, not ICANN's.

n78732838518.x: The Telecommunications Act, 2023 replaced the Telegraph Act, 1885, and holds the power to suspend internet services.

nb1af8516cbe.s: Which protocol assigns IP addresses automatically?
nb1af8516cbe.x: DHCP assigns IP addresses automatically; DNS turns domain names into IP addresses and TCP ensures reliable delivery.

ncedc9a74bee.s: Which network device forwards frames using MAC addresses?
ncedc9a74bee.x: A switch forwards frames by MAC address; a hub broadcasts to all ports, a router routes by IP and a modem converts signals.

n9aa51a7d473.s: An IPv6 address is how many bits long?
n9aa51a7d473.x: IPv6 addresses are 128 bits (eight hexadecimal groups); IPv4 is 32 bits and a MAC address 48 bits.

nd7dbec71847.s: Bluetooth, a personal area network (PAN) technology, follows the IEEE standard:
nd7dbec71847.x: Bluetooth follows IEEE 802.15.1, while Wi-Fi follows IEEE 802.11.

n36440e7c307.x: DSL uses telephone copper lines; cable internet uses coaxial TV cable and fibre internet uses light pulses in optical fibre.

n46fed6d94c9.s: The first-octet range of IPv4 Class D (multicast) addresses is:
n46fed6d94c9.x: Class D is 224–239 for multicast; 240–255 is Class E, 192–223 Class C and 128–191 Class B.

n20cca932072.s: Which of the following indexes webpages so that they can be found?
n20cca932072.x: A search engine indexes pages; a web server stores and serves them and a browser displays them.

n6df720371e8.s: A firm linking its LANs in Mumbai, Bengaluru and New Delhi is using a:
n6df720371e8.x: Linking LANs in different cities needs a WAN; a MAN covers only a city and a PAN links personal devices (APPSC 2019).

n4e250e0abcd.s: Communication through a walkie-talkie is an example of which transmission mode?
n4e250e0abcd.x: Half duplex allows two-way transmission one at a time, as in a walkie-talkie; radio/TV is simplex and a telephone call full duplex.

ncf904f1ba5c.s: NIXI, the not-for-profit body under MeitY that runs the .in registry and IRINN, was established in:
ncf904f1ba5c.x: NIXI was established in 2003 and runs internet exchange points, the .in registry and IRINN.

n3542c6c3f2c.s: VSNL launched public internet in India on:
n3542c6c3f2c.x: VSNL launched public internet on 15 August 1995, after ERNET (1986) and before Satyam Infoway became the first private ISP (1998).

n5be9343d7ed.s: In a URL, which part comes immediately after the protocol (such as https://)?
n5be9343d7ed.x: A URL has the protocol, then the domain name, then the path to the file.

nf8093de9273.s:
Assertion (A): 'Digital Detox Centre - Beyond Screens' is an initiative of Kerala.
Reason (R): Kerala Police run D-DAD (Digital De-Addiction) centres.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nf8093de9273.x: 'Digital Detox Centre - Beyond Screens' is Karnataka's, so A is false; R is true as Kerala Police run D-DAD centres.

n0d837e25c92.s:
Assertion (A): Doomscrolling means health anxiety fed by online symptom searches.
Reason (R): Nomophobia is the fear of being without one's mobile phone.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n0d837e25c92.x: Doomscrolling is endless scrolling through bad news (health anxiety from symptom searches is cyberchondria), so A is false; R is true.

o: A single e-commerce platform owned by one seller
A payment gateway regulated by RBI
n149027008d5.x: ONDC is a network-based protocol, not a single platform; it connects buyer and seller apps across B2C and B2B and aims to help MSMEs.

n8ca5eb8ae92.s: The IT (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021 were framed under which section of the IT Act?
n8ca5eb8ae92.x: The Rules were framed under Section 87; Section 79 is the safe-harbour provision.

n32def74cca8.s: QR (Quick Response) codes were designed in 1994 for the car industry by:
n32def74cca8.x: Denso Wave designed QR codes in Japan in 1994 for the car industry.

nc13d46f2b05.s: Under the Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Act, 2025, the Online Gaming Authority of India is a digital attached office of the:
o: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
nc13d46f2b05.x: OGAI is a digital attached office of MeitY, not the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting; the Act also banned real-money gaming.

nd789b030f69.s: Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, a 'child' is anyone below the age of:
nd789b030f69.x: The DPDP Act treats anyone below 18 as a child, and Section 9 requires verifiable parental consent for a child's data.

n2b99625b982.s: The Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020 are framed under the:
n2b99625b982.x: The Rules are under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 and cover both marketplace and inventory entities.

n403702a86bc.s: Near Field Communication (NFC) works over a range of:
n403702a86bc.x: NFC works over only a few centimetres at 106-424 kbps and uses less power than Bluetooth.

n77e258971e2.s: Gig and platform workers were defined for the first time in the:
o: Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020
n77e258971e2.x: The Code on Social Security, 2020 first defined gig and platform workers; aggregators contribute to their social-security fund.

n52eb0fe87df.s: In which year was Twitter renamed X?
n52eb0fe87df.x: Twitter was renamed X in 2023; LinkedIn was founded in 2003, Facebook in 2004, and LinkedIn came under Microsoft in 2016.

n5eb1ddf831e.s: Under the IT Amendment Rules, 2023, an intermediary ignoring government orders on false content may lose safe-harbour protection under Section ____ of the IT Act.
n5eb1ddf831e.x: Safe-harbour protection is under Section 79, which an intermediary may lose for not complying with such orders.

nfe6dc73ce7b.s: As per the textbook position, 100% FDI under the automatic route in e-commerce is permitted in:
nfe6dc73ce7b.x: 100% FDI under the automatic route is allowed in the marketplace model, while FDI is not permitted in the inventory model.

nc896eea0b91.s: The dominant 4G technology, which uses OFDM and MIMO, is:
nc896eea0b91.x: 4G runs on LTE using OFDM and MIMO; WiMAX lost out to LTE.

nacf099a6fce.s: Which of the following Industry 4.0 terms is wrongly matched with its meaning?
o: PLC – Rugged industrial computer controlling machines
SCADA – Remote monitoring of plants and grids
Digital twin – Virtual replica of a physical object or system
Cobot – Remote monitoring of plants and grids
nacf099a6fce.x: A cobot is a collaborative robot working safely beside humans; remote monitoring of plants and grids is SCADA.

n1a0ad02c3e5.s: Which of the following is NOT correct regarding IoT and AI?
o: IoT devices collect and exchange data through sensors
A smart thermostat is an example of AI rather than IoT
AI analyses data, recognises patterns and makes decisions
Chatbots and image recognition are examples of AI
n1a0ad02c3e5.x: A smart thermostat is listed as an IoT example, not an AI example.

n67fa02416bd.s:
Assertion (A): Under the Drone Rules, 2021, drones weighing more than 150 kg are classified as large drones.
Reason (R): Under the same rules, small drones weigh more than 2 kg and up to 50 kg.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n67fa02416bd.x: Large drones are above 150 kg, so A is true; R is false because small drones are 2-25 kg (25-150 kg is the medium class).

n229ea0c35d9.s:
Assertion (A): The term 'Fourth Industrial Revolution' was coined by Klaus Schwab, founder of the World Economic Forum, in 2016.
Reason (R): The Fourth Industrial Revolution involves the convergence of digital, physical and biological technologies.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n229ea0c35d9.x: Both are true, but the nature of the revolution does not explain who coined the term; Industry 5.0, by contrast, puts people at the centre.

n43802d76cd2.s: Which robot was developed to clean manholes and sewers to end manual scavenging?
n43802d76cd2.x: Bandicoot (Genrobotics, Kerala) cleans manholes and sewers; HomoSEP cleans septic tanks, Daksh defuses IEDs and Vyommitra is ISRO's half-humanoid.

n2863249b23b.shape: NOT (one-liner not possible from the facts)
n2863249b23b.s: Which of the following is NOT a function of wearable devices such as smartwatches and fitness bands?
o: Tracking heart rate, steps and sleep
Producing steam power for industrial machinery
n2863249b23b.x: Wearables track health indicators, support biometric authentication and act as IoT end-devices; they do not produce steam power.

nd1bd743d713.s: The VR/AR Centre of Excellence (VARCoE), set up by MeitY and STPI with Odisha, is located at:
nd1bd743d713.x: VARCoE is at IIT Bhubaneswar with Odisha as partner; the IMAGE CoE, partnered by Telangana, is at Hyderabad.

n5977374dd84.s: A fully computer-generated world that shuts out the real world is created by:
n5977374dd84.x: A fully computer-generated world is VR; AR places digital layers over the real world and XR is an umbrella term for VR, AR and MR.

naa5e53f8a63.s: Steam-powered weaving looms are characteristic of:
naa5e53f8a63.x: Steam-powered looms belong to Industry 1.0, while Industry 4.0 is marked by cyber-physical systems, IoT, AI and big data.

ne4d6895aca3.s: The India Semiconductor Mission (ISM) was launched in:
ne4d6895aca3.x: The ISM was launched in 2021 with a ₹76,000 crore PLI outlay.

n1a076ed1baa.x: ISO 10218 covers industrial-robot safety, not surgical robots; ISO TC 299 is the robotics committee.

n299a6ddda8e.s: Under Semicon 2.0, the capital subsidy for CMOS silicon fabs is up to:
n299a6ddda8e.x: CMOS silicon fabs get up to 40%; compound and display fabs get 35%, R&D up to 75% and conventional packaging 25%.

na2829037b6f.s: An RFID tag that has its own battery and transmitter is called a(n):
na2829037b6f.x: An active tag has its own battery and transmitter; a passive tag has no battery and backscatters the reader's signal.

nd843ccd85c5.s: Printing that adds materials which change shape over time is called:
nd843ccd85c5.x: 4D printing adds materials that change shape over time; additive manufacturing (3D printing) builds layer by layer from a CAD model.

n3c92d5fafd3.s: The humanoid robot Manav was developed by:
n3c92d5fafd3.x: Manav was developed by A-SET Training & Research Institutes, Delhi, not Genrobotics.

n60d4012d555.s: India's first indigenous surgical robotic system is:
n60d4012d555.x: SSI Mantra is India's first indigenous surgical robotic system; Manav is India's first 3D-printed humanoid (2017).

n02c37ab5953.s: The defining technology of Industry 3.0 was:
n02c37ab5953.x: Industry 1.0 used steam, 2.0 electricity and mass production, 3.0 computers and electronics, and 4.0 cyber-physical systems.

n7dc7cd9bf2b.s: In 5G, the mMTC (massive machine-type communication) slice is meant for:
n7dc7cd9bf2b.x: mMTC supports dense IoT sensor deployments in 5G networks.

nc29a6ccf58c.s: Which of the following IndiaAI pillars is wrongly matched?
o: Compute Capacity – Affordable GPU compute for startups and researchers
Innovation Centre – Indigenous foundation models and LMMs
FutureSkills – AI courses and Data and AI Labs in smaller towns
Datasets Platform – Indigenous foundation models and LMMs
nc29a6ccf58c.x: The Datasets Platform provides public-sector datasets; indigenous foundation models are the Innovation Centre's work.

n0c3ba144f5f.s: Which of the following AI applications is wrongly matched?
o: Natural Language Processing – Chatbots and translation
Generative AI – Creating new text, images and music
n0c3ba144f5f.x: Recommender systems suggest content from past behaviour (as on Netflix); facial recognition is computer vision.

n1202601d000.s:
Assertion (A): The NIELIT campus at Amaravati is billed as India's first dedicated Quantum and AI university campus.
Reason (R): Its classes begin in September 2026 at a temporary site in IIT Hyderabad.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n1202601d000.x: A is true; R is false because the temporary site is Acharya Nagarjuna University, Guntur, not IIT Hyderabad.

n84183229f07.s: Bhashini, linked to MeitY and the National Language Translation Mission, was launched in:
n84183229f07.x: Bhashini was launched in July 2022; it covers 22 scheduled languages and crowdsources through Bhasha Daan.

o: Content produced only in video form
Accuracy that is unaffected by lighting and pose
n9c3fdd4b04a.x: Explainability concerns the difficulty of justifying black-box decisions; bias arises from non-representative training data.

ne0977929b8c.s: A hypothetical form of AI that surpasses humans in every way is called:
ne0977929b8c.x: Artificial Superintelligence is hypothetical and would surpass humans in every way; AGI means human-level reasoning across domains and is not yet achieved.

n0b7fef821eb.s: Random forest combines many ____ to reduce overfitting.
n0b7fef821eb.x: Random forest is an ensemble of decision trees that reduces overfitting.

n6f1c93c686c.s: The IndiaAI Mission, approved in March 2024 under MeitY, has an outlay over 5 years of:
n6f1c93c686c.x: The IndiaAI Mission was approved in March 2024 with ₹10,371.92 crore over 5 years, covering compute, start-ups, datasets and foundation models.

nb5ff97c4c2d.s: The EU AI Act, the world's first comprehensive AI law, entered into force in:
nb5ff97c4c2d.x: The EU AI Act entered into force in August 2024 and uses four risk categories: unacceptable, high, limited and minimal.

nc37905991bd.s: At ISC 2023, the AI compute platform AIRAWAT was ranked ____ in the Top500 list.
nc37905991bd.x: AIRAWAT ranked 75th in the Top500 list at ISC 2023; its proof of concept has 200 AI petaflops, scalable to 790.

n066d056a2ae.s: The Indian AI model Krutrim is associated with:
n066d056a2ae.x: Krutrim is Ola's; OpenHathi is Sarvam AI's, Pratham is Assert AI's and Hanooman belongs to the BharatGPT ecosystem.

n4b565f1c71f.s: Google's chip designed for AI is the:
n4b565f1c71f.x: The TPU is Google's AI chip; the GPU is the parallel workhorse of AI training and the FPGA a field-programmable chip.

neac6400857a.s: Along with diffusion models, which technology is commonly used to generate deepfakes?
neac6400857a.x: Deepfakes can be produced using GANs, diffusion models and large neural networks.

n8a4109fc918.s: Job displacement associated with artificial intelligence can affect:
o: Neither, since AI only processes data
n8a4109fc918.x: AI may cause job displacement in both manual and intellectual forms of work.

nc463f5aad66.s: The YUVAi initiative is meant for students of:
nc463f5aad66.x: YUVAi is intended for students of classes 8 to 12.

ne2628845a72.s: Which of the following advanced-materials innovations is wrongly matched with its developer?
o: Biodegradable nanoparticles for colorectal cancer – IIT Mandi
Perovskite nanocrystal displays and conductive nanofibres – C-DAC
ne2628845a72.x: Perovskite displays and conductive nanofibres are IIT Delhi's work; C-DAC worked on graphene flexible electronics.

nfcf43e9912a.s:
Assertion (A): The UN declared 2024 the International Year of Quantum Science and Technology.
Reason (R): World Quantum Day is observed on 14 April.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nfcf43e9912a.x: 2025, the centenary of quantum mechanics, is the International Year of Quantum Science and Technology, so A is false; R is true.

ndd2027e7722.s: In quantum computing, the loss of quantum state through the environment, considered the main barrier, is called:
ndd2027e7722.x: Decoherence is the main barrier; superposition lets a qubit be 0, 1 or in between, and entanglement links qubits regardless of distance.

n5ec12dd2dc7.s: The subset of machine learning that uses many-layered neural networks is:
n5ec12dd2dc7.x: Deep learning is the subset of machine learning that uses many-layered neural networks.

ndd36d042e67.s: The demonstration that a well-timed local quantum flip can delay or prevent 'entanglement sudden death' is associated with:
ndd36d042e67.x: The Raman Research Institute showed that a well-timed local quantum flip could delay or prevent the abrupt total loss of entanglement.

n6e69a29b720.s: Alan Turing proposed the Turing test ('Imitation Game') in the year:
n6e69a29b720.x: Turing proposed it in 1950 in 'Computing Machinery and Intelligence'; 1956 is the Dartmouth Conference where McCarthy coined 'AI'.

nb3ca5ee423a.s: Fullerene C60 is commonly called the:
nb3ca5ee423a.x: C60 is the buckyball; graphene is a one-atom-thick carbon sheet and Kevlar an aramid fibre.

n578a48156ff.s: Which chips can be reprogrammed for custom AI acceleration?
n578a48156ff.x: FPGAs are reprogrammable for customised acceleration, while GPUs provide parallel computing for AI training.

n63551d14e79.s: DRDO's DYSL-Smart Materials laboratory is located in:
n63551d14e79.x: DYSL-Smart Materials is in Hyderabad, not Bengaluru.

nd2198e79af8.s: Google's Sycamore quantum supremacy machine dates to:
nd2198e79af8.x: Sycamore achieved quantum supremacy in 2019; China's Micius satellite dates to 2016 and photonic Jiuzhang to 2020.

n32fff19092f.s: Which of the following is NOT a proposal of the draft National Data Centre Policy?
o: GST input credit on capital assets
Permanent Establishment status for foreign firms of at least 100 MW
Land near industrial corridors and renewable energy
A 10-year tax holiday for developers meeting targets
n32fff19092f.x: The draft policy proposes a 20-year, not 10-year, tax holiday; the other three are its proposals.

n2f38dad3f6d.s: Which of the following is NOT correct?
o: Data mining means finding patterns in large datasets
A data warehouse stores raw data in its native format
A data lake stores raw data in its native format
Metadata is 'data about data', such as author, date and size
n2f38dad3f6d.x: A data warehouse is a central store of cleaned, structured data; raw native-format data describes a data lake.

n450f00048a9.s:
Assertion (A): Containers are lighter than virtual machines.
Reason (R): Containers share the host OS kernel instead of each carrying a full operating system.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n450f00048a9.x: Containers (e.g. Docker) package an app with its dependencies and share the host kernel, while each VM runs its own OS; this is why containers are lightweight.

nf5391b49773.s: The National Data Governance Framework Policy (2022) was issued by:
nf5391b49773.x: MeitY issued the policy, which set up the India Data Management Office and the India Datasets Programme.

n7ba4126defb.s: Which computing model processes data on or near the device, giving the lowest latency?
n7ba4126defb.x: Edge computing processes data on or near the device, saves bandwidth and keeps sensitive data local; sending all data to distant centres is cloud processing.

nd7a47cd1116.s: The feature of cloud computing that lets resources expand or contract according to demand is:
nd7a47cd1116.x: Elasticity lets resources scale with demand; resource pooling means shared computing resources.

n41d0e1e7d26.s: Which company's data-centre proposal in the Visakhapatnam region is called HyperVault?
n41d0e1e7d26.x: HyperVault is TCS's proposal; Google, Reliance, CtrlS and GMR also have data-centre proposals in the region.

n985b46ad976.s: The cloud storage service S3 belongs to:
n985b46ad976.x: S3 is Amazon Web Services'; Google Drive is Google's, iCloud Apple's and Dropbox belongs to Dropbox Inc.

n81445d9e624.s: The three service models of cloud computing are IaaS, PaaS and ____.
n81445d9e624.x: IaaS, PaaS and SaaS are the three service models; 'Hardware as a Service' is not a separate layer as hardware comes under IaaS.

n8e69368c85d.s: AI, quantum computing and data science together help environmental governance mainly by:
o: Restricting analysis to small, manually entered datasets
Eliminating the need for environmental data collection
Analysing large datasets to predict pollution and support decisions
n8e69368c85d.x: Together they analyse large datasets, predict pollution, optimise resource use and support governance decisions.

n188d19dc222.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about MeitY's Distributed Centre of Excellence in Blockchain?
o: It includes C-DAC and IDRBT Hyderabad
It produced a property-registration pilot in Shamshabad, Andhra Pradesh
It produced a Proof-of-Existence framework for certificates
n188d19dc222.x: Shamshabad is in Telangana, not Andhra Pradesh.

n0e0a36e165d.s: Which of the following is NOT correct regarding blockchain terms?
o: A hash is a cryptographic fingerprint whose change reveals tampering
Immutability means only a central authority can modify recorded data
A node is a computer holding a copy of the ledger
A blockchain has no central validator
n0e0a36e165d.x: Immutability means recorded data is nearly impossible to alter without consensus; there is no central validator.

n4e43b300b5c.s:
Assertion (A): Cryptocurrency is legal tender in India.
Reason (R): Cryptocurrency is decentralised and peer-to-peer.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n4e43b300b5c.x: Cryptocurrency is not legal tender in India, so A is false; it is decentralised and peer-to-peer, so R is true.

n8e9aeadf37b.s: Bitcoin is an example of which type of blockchain?
n8e9aeadf37b.x: Bitcoin represents the public, permissionless model; private, permissioned systems such as AP DigiVerify are controlled by an organisation or consortium.

nc27f50ed97c.s: The National Strategy on Blockchain (December 2021) was published by:
nc27f50ed97c.x: MeitY published the strategy; its Vishvasya is a Blockchain-as-a-Service stack hosted across NIC data centres.

n6f0374f61a7.s: In which consensus mechanism are validators chosen by the coins they have staked?
n6f0374f61a7.x: In Proof of Stake validators are chosen by coins staked; in Proof of Work miners race to solve puzzles, using far more energy.

nec372876229.s: Self-executing code on a blockchain that cuts out intermediaries is called a:
nec372876229.x: Smart contracts are self-executing code; DeFi uses them for lending and trading without banks.

n4eb7897b280.s: Besides transaction details and a timestamp, a block of a blockchain ordinarily contains:
o: The private key of every participant
The hash of the previous block
A copy of every earlier block
n4eb7897b280.x: A block holds transaction details, the previous block's hash and a timestamp, not participants' private keys.

n60fdbb01f42.x: NFTs are unique, non-fungible blockchain tokens that can represent physical assets and are not exchangeable at equivalency.

ne785a98e212.s: NPCI's open-source private blockchain Drunix was built by re-engineering:
ne785a98e212.x: Drunix was re-engineered from Hyperledger Fabric; it was NPCI's second open-source blockchain release, after Falcon.

nd8749c52a31.s: Ethereum's move from Proof of Work to Proof of Stake in September 2022 is called:
nd8749c52a31.x: The switch is called 'The Merge'; Bitcoin still uses Proof of Work.

nf45a9ccafa4.s: A blockchain record system lets stakeholders view records but prevents their alteration mainly because:
o: The database is deleted after each transaction
A single administrator edits every copy
Stakeholders hold copies and changes need consensus
Only the data-entry operator keeps a copy
nf45a9ccafa4.x: Replicated copies held by stakeholders and the need for consensus protect records from unauthorised alteration.

n312963a6da7.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the National Optical Fibre Network (NOFN)?
o: It was planned to link all 2,50,000 Gram Panchayats
It is funded by the National Investment and Infrastructure Fund
n312963a6da7.x: NOFN is funded by the Universal Service Obligation Fund (USOF), not NIIF.

n0650005e68d.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Telecom Technology Development Fund (TTDF)?
o: It receives about Rs 500 crore a year
It has funded India 5G Stack, 6G and quantum-encryption projects
It receives 10% of Digital Bharat Nidhi collections
n0650005e68d.x: TTDF receives 5%, not 10%, of Digital Bharat Nidhi collections (about Rs 500 crore a year).

n3c6721ce1b2.s:
Assertion (A): The Bharat 6G Vision, released in March 2023, aims for India to lead 6G design, development and deployment by 2030.
Reason (R): The Bharat 6G Alliance (B6GA) was launched in 2025.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n3c6721ce1b2.x: A is true; R is false because the Bharat 6G Alliance was launched in 2023.

n1503deb6b9e.s:
Assertion (A): 5G Standalone (SA) runs without a 4G core, giving lower latency.
Reason (R): Network slicing divides one network into virtual slices for different services.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n1503deb6b9e.x: Both are true, but network slicing does not explain why SA has lower latency; the absence of a 4G core does.

ncdb4def812c.s: The term Li-Fi was coined by Harald Haas in:
ncdb4def812c.x: Harald Haas coined 'Li-Fi' in 2011 for wireless optical networking using LEDs.

nd5e53485bb8.s: Which medium is best suited for long-distance optical signal transmission?
nd5e53485bb8.x: Single-mode fibre carries signals over long distances, while multi-mode fibre is used for short runs.

ne4a268316ad.s: Undersea communication cables carry nearly ____ of international internet and telecom traffic.
ne4a268316ad.x: Undersea cables carry nearly 99% of international traffic and are cheaper with lower latency than satellites.

na826f2ef809.s: TDSAT, which settles telecom disputes and hears appeals against TRAI, was created by an amendment in:
na826f2ef809.x: TDSAT was created by the 2000 amendment; TRAI itself was set up in 1997.

n85e3704f9da.s: The wavelength range of visible light is:
n85e3704f9da.x: Visible light is 400–700 nm; 10–400 nm is ultraviolet, 0.01–10 nm X-rays and below 0.01 nm gamma rays.

n2741431668b.s: LTE and VoLTE belong to which mobile generation?
n2741431668b.x: LTE and VoLTE are 4G; 3G was CDMA-based (WCDMA/CDMA2000).

nd74b4401546.s: Optical fibre works on the principle of:
nd74b4401546.x: Optical fibre works by total internal reflection, carrying signals as pulses of light.

n6c8cfdf07b9.x: 'Omnipresent wireless intelligence' describes 6G, expected in the early 2030s.

nf46a20e7e84.s: In February 2026, in the Aircel case, the Supreme Court held that:
o: Telecom companies own the spectrum they hold
The IBC can restructure spectrum rights
Telecom companies do not own spectrum
Spectrum can be sold as company property in insolvency
nf46a20e7e84.x: The Court held that telecom companies do not own spectrum and that the IBC cannot restructure spectrum rights.

nb48f6956a04.s: Under ITU rules, satellites must be de-orbited within how many years of the end of their mission?
nb48f6956a04.x: The ITU de-orbit limit is 25 years after mission end; orbital slots are given first-come, first-served.

n7147bf76f82.s: The 5G & Beyond Hackathon 2023 was run by the:
n7147bf76f82.x: DoT, not DST, ran the hackathon, which was open to individuals, students, start-ups and academics.

n3a146575ca6.s: Wi-Fi 7 corresponds to the IEEE standard:
n3a146575ca6.x: Wi-Fi 7 is IEEE 802.11be and Wi-Fi 6 is 802.11ax.

nphysics-17-10.s: Radar and satellite communication mainly use:
nphysics-17-10.x: Microwaves serve satellites, radar and 5G; UV, X-rays and gamma rays are ionising and not used for normal communication.

ndb026371289.s: Under the Telecommunications Act, 2023, satellite spectrum is:
ndb026371289.x: Under the First Schedule, terrestrial spectrum is auctioned while satellite spectrum is assigned administratively.

nefc8e7dca56.x: C-DOT came in 1984, DoT in 1985, MTNL and VSNL in 1986 and TRAI in 1997.

nphysics-20-6.s: Microwaves have wavelengths in the range of:
nphysics-20-6.x: Microwaves span 1 mm–1 m; radio waves are longer than 1 m and 10–400 nm is ultraviolet.

ndf812c6411f.s: The world's first 5G launch, in April 2019, took place in:
ndf812c6411f.x: South Korea launched 5G first in April 2019; India launched 5G on 1 October 2022 at India Mobile Congress.

nfaff82a621f.s: In February 2026, TRAI recommended a uniform spectrum cap of:
nfaff82a621f.x: TRAI recommended auctioning all spectrum across nine bands, a uniform 35% cap, and cutting new-entrant net worth from Rs 100 crore to Rs 50 crore.

n7e167d4f24c.s: GEO satellites orbit at about how many kilometres above Earth?
n7e167d4f24c.x: GEO satellites are about 35,786 km up and have higher latency; LEO satellites are below about 2,000 km.

n6e0e3d5ef61.s: Which of the following is NOT correct regarding the Industrial Revolutions?
o: The First was associated with steam and mechanisation
The Second was associated with electricity and mass production
The First Industrial Revolution was associated with electricity and mass production
The Third was associated with electronics and information technology
n6e0e3d5ef61.x: Electricity and mass production mark the Second Industrial Revolution; the First was based on steam and mechanisation.

n6885f8564d2.s: Which of the following pairs is wrongly matched?
n6885f8564d2.x: 5G NR means 5G New Radio, the air-interface standard.

n4d2e11efaed.s:
Assertion (A): 5G network slicing can split one physical network into several virtual networks.
Reason (R): Network slicing uses SDN/NFV.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n4d2e11efaed.x: Slicing splits one physical network into virtual networks by means of SDN/NFV, so R explains A.

nd6edfd29c4b.s: Traffic and air-quality monitoring and waste collection are IoT uses in:
nd6edfd29c4b.x: These are smart-city uses; smart agriculture covers precision farming, soil monitoring and livestock, and wearables are fitness trackers.

n56543c24e8c.s: A shared immersive virtual world built on AR and VR is called the:
n56543c24e8c.x: The metaverse is a shared immersive virtual world using AR and VR.

nabad392d325.s: Passive RFID tags are powered by:
nabad392d325.x: Passive tags draw power from the reader's signal; active tags have their own battery and longer range.

n7d784a0738d.s: The Bharat 6G Alliance was launched in:
n7d784a0738d.x: The Bharat 6G Alliance was launched in 2023, the same year as the Bharat 6G Vision document.

n8115309e91a.x: Li-Fi means Light Fidelity and transmits data through LEDs.

n57e264ace04.s: In the three-layer IoT architecture, which layer uses sensors at the physical level?
n57e264ace04.x: The perception layer uses sensors, the network layer transmits data and the application layer provides user services.

nd4bc98ee8d9.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about e-Kranti?
o: It is also known as NeGP 2.0
It was approved in 2015 under Digital India
Its vision is 'Transforming e-Governance for Transforming Governance'
nd4bc98ee8d9.x: e-Kranti has 44 MMPs; 31 is the expanded count of the original NeGP.

nb67d4f4edc9.s:
Assertion (A): The identity layer of India Stack is UPI.
Reason (R): The data layer of India Stack is DEPA / Account Aggregator, which is consent-based.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nb67d4f4edc9.x: The identity layer is Aadhaar and the payments layer is UPI, so A is false; R is true.

nd53102281b7.s:
Assertion (A): SWAYAM offers free MOOCs for higher education, including courses from IITs and IIMs.
Reason (R): NPTEL is a national coordinator of DIKSHA.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nd53102281b7.x: A is true; R is false because NPTEL is a national coordinator of SWAYAM, not DIKSHA.

ne2dc2f7ef32.s: Under NeGP, e-Panchayat is a ____ Mission Mode Project.
ne2dc2f7ef32.x: e-Panchayat is a State MMP, like Land Records and CCTNS; e-Biz is Integrated and Income Tax Central.

nbbb93b92ff5.s: Passport Seva, a Central Mission Mode Project, is under the Ministry of:
nbbb93b92ff5.x: Passport Seva is under the Ministry of External Affairs; MCA21 is the Corporate Affairs project.

nec791dca0c5.s: The eCourts Mission Mode Project has been in place since:
nec791dca0c5.x: eCourts dates from 2007 (Phase I 2007-15); 2009 is CCTNS. Its Phase III covers 2023-27.

n67a3625c627.s: The National Informatics Centre (NIC), which provides G2G solutions to government departments, was set up in:
n67a3625c627.x: NIC was set up in 1976; its e-Taal is a dashboard of e-transaction statistics.

nebbff10cd70.s: The National e-Governance Plan (NeGP) was approved on:
nebbff10cd70.x: NeGP was approved on 18 May 2006 with 27 MMPs and 10 components; 1 July 2015 is the launch of Digital India.

n7e4111269d1.s: The UMANG app was launched in:
n7e4111269d1.x: UMANG came in 2017; MyGov came in July 2014, UPI and BHIM in 2016 and PM eVIDYA in 2020.

n8b5ca18f3a5.s: The National Language Translation Mission launched in July 2022 is called:
n8b5ca18f3a5.x: The July 2022 Translation Mission is Bhashini; BhashaNet is the Universal Acceptance portal of NIXI and MeitY.

nf3838b25639.s: NIC solutions for government departments are an example of which e-governance model?
nf3838b25639.x: NIC solutions for departments are G2G; online HR tools for employees are G2E and the MCA portal and GSTN are G2B.

n907aa0f0f39.s: CCTNS, started in 2009, is a project of the Ministry of:
n907aa0f0f39.x: CCTNS is an MHA project linking police stations, State headquarters and central police organisations.

n9c9e1427f46.x: Meghraj is the GI Cloud; MSDG (2011) is for mobile services and india.gov.in is the National Portal.

n971abea9299.s: A delegation from which country studied Andhra Pradesh's RTGS Data Lake and Command Centre (July 2026)?
n971abea9299.x: A Singapore delegation, not an EU one, studied AP's RTGS Data Lake and Command Centre.

n7a2f3815fea.s: IVFRT, a Ministry of Home Affairs project, was approved in:
n7a2f3815fea.x: IVFRT was approved in 2010 and is run by the Bureau of Immigration with NIC.

nba695256bc0.x: Aadhaar came in 2009, MyGov in 2014, PM eVIDYA in 2020 and ONDC in 2022.

ne09ae87d461.s: In Gartner's four-phase model of e-governance, the second phase is:
ne09ae87d461.x: Gartner's phases run Information, Interaction, Transaction and Transformation (MPPSC 2025).

nfc298fed911.s: Which of the following IT institutions is wrongly matched with its role?
o: MeitY – Policy on IT, electronics and cyber security; coordinates Digital India
STPI – Government IT and e-governance network and services
NASSCOM – Industry association of IT-BPM firms
NIC – Government IT and e-governance network and services
nfc298fed911.x: STPI runs export-oriented IT parks and CoEs; the government IT and e-governance network is NIC's role.

n955f5d262f0.s: Which of the following targets of the National Policy on IT, 2012 (by 2020) is wrongly matched?
o: Skilled manpower – 10 million additional ICT workers
E-literacy – At least one e-literate person in every household
n955f5d262f0.x: The IT exports target was US$200 billion; US$300 billion was the IT-ITES revenue target.

nca3c9ff6478.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the National Policy on Information Technology, 2012?
o: It treats ICT as a driver of growth, jobs, governance reform and inclusion
Its objectives include ICT in education, health and financial inclusion
It sought to concentrate IT activity further in the six established hubs
Its objectives include e-literacy for all
nca3c9ff6478.x: The six hubs already held about 90% of the industry, so the policy sought to spread IT beyond them, not concentrate it further.

nf23813d63c5.s:
Assertion (A): Global Capability Centres (GCCs) are offshore units operated by multinational corporations for their own functions.
Reason (R): GCCs are the same as outsourcing vendors providing services to unrelated companies.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nf23813d63c5.x: A is true; R is false because GCCs serve their parent MNCs, whereas outsourcing vendors serve other organisations.

naa516512710.s: The National Policy on IT, 2012 aimed to make India a Global Hub and Destination for IT and ITES services by:
naa516512710.x: Its twin goals were bringing ICT within reach of all of India and making India a global IT/ITES hub by 2020.

n13b11dc09a3.s: In 2011–12, approximately what share of the Indian IT industry's revenue came from exports?
n13b11dc09a3.x: About 80% of revenue came from exports, while the six hubs accounted for nearly 90% of the industry.

n0a9c9322d5f.s: The National Policy on Electronics (NPE), 2019 was approved by the Union Cabinet on:
n0a9c9322d5f.x: MeitY's NPE 2019 was approved on 20 February 2019 and replaced NPE 2012.

n836cd2c4cfa.s: The Information Technology Act, 2000, which gave legal basis to electronic records and digital signatures, was amended in:
n836cd2c4cfa.x: The IT Act was amended in 2008; the amendment dealt, among other matters, with e-signatures and cybercrime.

n1a1e5b6401a.s: The Mobile Phone Manufacturing Scheme (MPMS) targets production worth:
n1a1e5b6401a.x: MPMS targets ₹39 lakh crore production and ₹15 lakh crore exports, with an outlay of ₹62,500 crore.

nb272274ad8b.s: The AP IT & Global Capability Centers Policy (4.0) came into force on:
nb272274ad8b.x: The policy covers 2024-29 and came into force on 12 December 2024 for five years.

nfc5447c5795.s: The Chips to Start-up (C2S) programme is implemented by:
nfc5447c5795.x: C2S (2022), targeting 85,000 students over five years, is implemented by C-DAC, not NIELIT.

neb11f331529.s: Under NPE 2019, the mobile exports target for 2025 is:
neb11f331529.x: Mobile exports are targeted at US$110 billion; US$190 billion is the mobile manufacturing value and US$400 billion total electronics manufacturing.

n8a1b111a629.s: Which institution works on PARAM supercomputers, implements the C2S programme and has a centre at Amaravati Quantum Valley?
n8a1b111a629.x: These are all stated roles of C-DAC.

n81ea93f2fb1.s: India's electronics production in 2025-26 was about:
n81ea93f2fb1.x: Production was ₹13.11 lakh crore in 2025-26; ₹39 lakh crore is the MPMS production target. Electronics is India's third-largest export item.

n3e9cbf029f5.s: The National Task Force on IT and Software Development was set up in:
n3e9cbf029f5.x: The order was NIC (1976), the National Task Force (1998), the IT Act (2000) and NeGP (2006).

n2a7c99bad76.s: Which of the following is associated with Visakhapatnam's IT initiatives?
o: The NIELIT Quantum and AI campus
Temporary NIELIT classes at Acharya Nagarjuna University
n2a7c99bad76.x: Visakhapatnam has a cable landing station, AI data projects with Anakapalli and an Infosys campus; the Quantum Valley and NIELIT campus are at Amaravati.

n847772a00bc.s: Which of the following portals is wrongly matched with its function?
o: e-NAM – Department of Agriculture's e-governance network
DACNET – Department of Agriculture's e-governance network
Kisan Suvidha – Farmer app for weather, prices and advisories
n847772a00bc.x: e-NAM is for online agricultural commodity trading; the Agriculture Department's network is DACNET.

n0058f2dd0d1.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about e-Sign?
o: It provides non-repudiation in a legally acceptable form
It is based on blockchain rather than Public Key Infrastructure
It uses Aadhaar eKYC and OTP of the holder
Its legal backing comes from the IT Act, 2000
n0058f2dd0d1.x: e-Sign is based on Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), not blockchain.

n4dd42174ee5.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about DigiLocker?
o: Launched in February 2015, it gives each citizen a cloud account linked to Aadhaar
CBSE mark sheets have been available in it since 2015
Its documents are treated as equal to originals under the RTI Act, 2005
Driving licences and vehicle RCs can be held in it
n4dd42174ee5.x: DigiLocker documents get legal validity from the IT Act, 2000 and the Digital Locker Rules, 2016, not the RTI Act.

nb47daa0e2d9.s:
Assertion (A): The original National e-Governance Plan had 27 Mission Mode Projects and 10 components.
Reason (R): The original MMPs were divided into 9 Central, 11 State and 7 Integrated projects.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nb47daa0e2d9.x: Both are true; R only describes how the 27 MMPs were grouped and does not explain why the plan had them. The figure 44 belongs to e-Kranti.

n8acb3034c97.s: The e-governance project Gyandoot is associated with:
n8acb3034c97.x: Gyandoot is from Dhar (MP); Lokvani is from Sitapur (UP), Akshaya from Malappuram (Kerala) and Bhoomi from Karnataka.

n6b127c44dd8.s: MeeSeva, the successor of e-Seva, was launched in undivided Andhra Pradesh in:
n6b127c44dd8.x: MeeSeva came in 2011 as a single-window model; e-Seva (2001) set up India's first integrated citizen service centres.

nf0bd680bd04.s: data.gov.in is an example of which e-governance model?
nf0bd680bd04.x: data.gov.in is Open Government Data; G2P examples are DBT for LPG subsidy and pensions.

n2d10b06f1ef.s: CPGRAMS, DARPG's 24x7 online grievance portal, was launched in:
n2d10b06f1ef.x: CPGRAMS was launched in 2007; its AI chatbot SAMADHAN DIDI supports all 22 Eighth Schedule languages.

n58866689887.x: e-Sanjeevani is the telemedicine service; e-Aushadhi handles medicine procurement and e-Hospital handles registration and hospital management.

nc9e740890ca.s: The National e-Governance Plan was formulated by DeitY and:
nc9e740890ca.x: NeGP was formulated by DeitY and DARPG and approved on 18 May 2006.

n0c3f72187ed.s: In Andhra Pradesh's e-governance chain, which initiative came immediately after MeeSeva?
n0c3f72187ed.x: The chain runs e-Seva, MeeSeva, e-Pragati, RTGS and Mana Mitra.

neebdf532630.s: Andhra Pradesh's Gram/Ward Sachivalayam system was launched in:
neebdf532630.x: Gram/Ward Sachivalayam (2019) has 10,000+ secretariats with 500+ services; MeeSeva came in 2011 and e-Seva in 2001.

n1c292422a91.s: Under NeGP infrastructure, the village-level front-end delivery outlet is the:
n1c292422a91.x: CSCs are the village-level outlets; SWAN is the backbone network and SDC hosts State applications and data.

na63fe1dfb13.s: The final phase of the Gartner model of e-governance is:
na63fe1dfb13.x: The four Gartner phases are Information, Interaction, Transaction and Transformation, in that order.

o: A platform only for agricultural subsidies
A whole-of-government programme interconnecting e-governance systems
n849db953644.x: e-Pragati is AP's whole-of-government programme under which e-governance systems are interconnected.

nbb38e43cbd9.s: The e-governance initiative Lokvani is associated with which state?
nbb38e43cbd9.x: Lokvani is associated with Sitapur in Uttar Pradesh; Gyandoot is the Madhya Pradesh project.

n0092ea1eb2a.x: e-Pramaan is the e-Authentication framework; SARATHI handles driving licences, VAHAN vehicle registration and Bhavishya pensioners.

n50780cdf7db.s: Under NeGP, e-Courts is a(n) ____ Mission Mode Project.
n50780cdf7db.x: e-Courts is an Integrated MMP under NeGP.

n3255ffdc634.s: e-Pathshala, a platform for e-textbooks and educational resources, is run by:
n3255ffdc634.x: e-Pathshala is an NCERT platform; Shiksha Vani is CBSE's podcast app.

nf6280dcd02d.s: In the National e-Governance Plan, MMP stands for:
nf6280dcd02d.x: MMP means Mission Mode Project, not Mission Monitoring Portal.

n7e46b61add1.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about e-RUPI?
o: It is a one-time, cashless, person- and purpose-specific voucher
It was developed by NPCI with DFS, MoHFW and the National Health Authority
n7e46b61add1.x: e-RUPI was launched in August 2021; 30 December 2016 is the launch date of BHIM.

n4e923987b8a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Account Aggregator framework?
o: It enables consent-based sharing of financial data
It forms the identity layer of India Stack
It forms the consent layer of India Stack
n4e923987b8a.x: AA/DEPA is the consent layer; the identity layer of India Stack is Aadhaar.

n8f74eba9a3f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about UIDAI and Aadhaar?
o: UIDAI became a statutory body under the Aadhaar Act, 2016
UIDAI works under the Ministry of Home Affairs
The Aadhaar Act was amended in 2019
n8f74eba9a3f.x: UIDAI functions under the Ministry of Electronics and IT, not the Ministry of Home Affairs.

n11f0f67f9ae.s:
Assertion (A): Ranjana Sonawane was the first person to receive an Aadhaar number.
Reason (R): Aadhaar was launched in 2012.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n11f0f67f9ae.x: A is true; R is false because Aadhaar was launched in 2009 and the first number was issued on 29 September 2010.

nc08c04a70da.s: DBT payments are routed through CPSMS (now PFMS) and NPCI's:
nc08c04a70da.x: DBT routing uses PFMS and NPCI's Aadhaar Payment Bridge; ONDC and DEPA serve other functions.

neefa9e55dc3.s: Jeevan Pramaan, which uses Aadhaar, is a:
neefa9e55dc3.x: Jeevan Pramaan is the Aadhaar-based digital life certificate; Aadhaar also supports DBT and bank and mobile KYC.

nb3f39a22486.s: The base period of RBI's Digital Payments Index (base value 100) is:
nb3f39a22486.x: The index uses March 2018 as base (= 100) and is published half-yearly.

na1e035361c5.x: FASTag is run by NPCI with NHAI/IHMCL; RBI runs NEFT and RTGS.

n63ac2b8f451.s: The minimum capital required for an RBI New Umbrella Entity (NUE) is:
n63ac2b8f451.x: NUEs need minimum capital of Rs 500 crore and are meant to end NPCI's monopoly in retail payments.

n1c4521304e1.s: The Open Network for Digital Commerce (ONDC) was launched in:
n1c4521304e1.x: ONDC came in 2022 as an open e-commerce network to break platform monopolies.

nd0a22b5527c.s: The biometric information captured for Aadhaar is:
o: Eight fingerprints, one iris scan and a voice sample
Ten fingerprints, two iris scans and a DNA sample
Ten fingerprints, two iris scans and a face photograph
nd0a22b5527c.x: Aadhaar captures ten fingerprints, two irises and a face photograph.

n2e7d046cdfa.s: DBT in Andhra Pradesh was inaugurated on 6 January 2013 at:
n2e7d046cdfa.x: DBT was inaugurated at Gollaprolu in East Godavari on 6 January 2013 by Jairam Ramesh with CM Kiran Kumar Reddy.

n08d5e332411.s: UPI accounts for about what share of the world's real-time payments?
n08d5e332411.x: UPI accounted for 49% of the world's real-time payments and recorded a FY 2025–26 high.

n72819315358.s: API Setu emerged from MeitY's Policy on Open APIs issued in:
n72819315358.x: MeitY's Policy on Open APIs, 2015, led to API Setu.

ne7362edd64b.s: In India Stack, the cashless layer is:
ne7362edd64b.x: India Stack has Aadhaar for identity, eSign and DigiLocker for paperless, UPI for cashless and DEPA/AA for consent.
